findings.fact: BoardSimulatorPresentation is simulator-only and installed only when onContactTap is nonnil. Workout BoardMaps omit onHoldTap, so the helper is absent there. It looks for exactly one geometrically matching CAMetalLayer and changes presentsWithTransaction=false, with a bounded ancestor/layer search and weak configured-layer retention.
findings.limit: This proves a source eligibility difference, not that drawable transaction policy causes the stale workout frames or that extending the helper will fix them.

findings.fact: Main explicitly uses virtual camera in make/update and reads cameraRevision inside the RealityView update.
findings.limit: Earlier explicit virtual-camera controls failed; do not infer that this alone repairs workout color updates.

findings.fact: Selection task keyed by position/contact IDs (not highlight mode) drives bounded camera invalidation. Mode-only highlight updates materials and preserves manual orbit. New selection may animate camera for0.28s or schedule geometric cord tilt tasks.
findings.limit: This is intentional Main camera behavior. No source evidence warrants reviving previously failed onChange/extra writer/host/projection fixes. Whole-image runtime validation is still necessary.

findings.fact: Coordinator renders frame->select->requested orbit->highlight, then one zero-delta GPU update, and caches under the requested orbit. Main highlight can replace requested orbit with contact-aware target and begin animation. No settled-target gate or animation ownership exists in this coordinator.
findings.risk: The cached image may represent an intermediate/different camera than its cache key. Internal Main animation can mutate scene state outside the coordinator single-in-flight request gate. This is an integration risk in the disabled experiment, not demonstrated cause of live workout failure.

findings.fact: Current input revision rejects stale completion; one retained frame holds scene/renderer/texture through eager conversion; semantic cache rejects wrong contacts/mode/position; opposite-mode prefetch is finite. These protections do not settle Main animations.
findings.limit: Only four cache value tests cover cache semantics; no new GPU validation claim.

findings.fact: Frame renderer remains DEBUG environment opt-in, release false, and interactive callbacks remain on live path.
